show.description: Sonia, a powerful CEO, shocks everyone by revealing her pregnancy with her lover Sunny, humiliating her husband Kabir. As Kabir is thrown out and branded impotent, he uncovers Sunny’s fraud and returns to expose the truth. In a dramatic showdown, Kabir reveals his real identity as a billionaire CEO, proves Sonia was never pregnant, and brings Sunny’s lies to light, reclaiming his dignity and choosing a new path. Watch now.
